skills.summary: First sales email to a stranger prospect
skills.job: Draft a short first-touch sales email to a named prospect that leads with their situation and asks for one small next step.
triggers: write a cold email to this prospect
gotchas: Opening with the seller instead of the buyer
Asking for a 30-minute call on first contact
Personalisation that is only a merge field

skills.summary: Prepare questions and goals for a discovery call
skills.job: Build a one-page prep sheet for a first sales call: what is known, what to learn, question order and exit criteria.
triggers: what should I ask on this call
gotchas: Pitching before pain is confirmed
Question lists with no priority order
Skipping the agreed next step at the end

skills.summary: Answer a buyer objection without pushing
skills.job: Turn a stated buyer objection into a short honest reply that finds the real concern behind it.
triggers: they said it is too expensive
how do I answer this objection
gotchas: Answering the stated objection when the real one is different
Discounting as the first response
Scripted rebuttals that sound rehearsed

skills.summary: Plan a multi-touch follow-up after a meeting
skills.job: Design a short sequence of follow-ups after a meeting or proposal, each with a new reason to write.
triggers: they went quiet after the demo
gotchas: Every touch saying just checking in
Stacking touches too close together
No stop rule once the buyer says no

skills.summary: Outline a sales proposal around buyer goals
skills.job: Structure a proposal document from discovery notes so it opens with the buyer's goals and ends with a clear decision path.
triggers: outline a proposal for this client
gotchas: Starting with company history
Pricing with no tie to a stated outcome
Leaving out who signs and by when

skills.summary: Score a lead against your own criteria
skills.job: Score a lead against a stated fit and intent rubric and say pursue, nurture or drop with the evidence for each call.
gotchas: Scoring on company size alone
Treating a polite reply as intent
Inventing criteria the user never stated

skills.summary: Brief on a target account before outreach
skills.job: Collect public facts on a target company and its contact, then reduce them to a short brief of hooks and open questions.
triggers: research this company before I call
what do we know about this account
gotchas: Quoting stale news as current
Confusing two companies with similar names
Listing facts with no angle for the seller

skills.summary: Turn rough call notes into clean CRM entries
skills.job: Convert messy call or meeting notes into a dated CRM entry with facts, decisions, owners and the next step.
triggers: log this call in the CRM
turn these notes into a CRM update
gotchas: Recording opinions as facts
Dropping the next-step date
Losing who said what in a multi-person call

skills.job: Review one open deal against what is confirmed versus assumed and list the gaps that threaten the close date.
triggers: what is missing on this opportunity
gotchas: Counting a champion's enthusiasm as buying power
Trusting the close date in the CRM
Ignoring the competing priority of the buyer

skills.summary: Script a product demo around buyer problems
skills.job: Write a demo run-sheet that shows only the features tied to the buyer's stated problems, in their order of importance.
triggers: plan a demo for this prospect
gotchas: Touring every feature
Demoing before restating the problem
No planned stop for questions or next step

skills.summary: Find stale and mislabeled deals in a pipeline
skills.job: Scan an exported pipeline for stale, stuck, incomplete or mis-staged deals and list the fix each one needs.
gotchas: Deleting old deals instead of closing them with a reason
Judging staleness without the stage's normal length
Rewriting amounts that the owner has not confirmed

skills.summary: Learn from closed deals, won and lost
skills.job: Compare closed-won and closed-lost deals to find the recurring causes and turn them into changes in how the team sells.
triggers: why did we lose this deal
what do our wins have in common
gotchas: Taking the buyer's polite reason at face value
Drawing patterns from three deals
Blaming price when timing or trust was the cause

skills.summary: Plan a check-in call with an existing customer
skills.job: Prepare a customer check-in agenda from usage and history that surfaces risks, wins and expansion signals.
triggers: prep a check-in with this customer
gotchas: Making the call a feature announcement
Asking is everything fine
Skipping the stakeholder who pays the bill

skills.summary: Write a renewal notice and nudge
skills.job: Draft a renewal email that recaps value delivered, states the terms the user supplies and asks for a clear yes or a conversation.
gotchas: Leading with the price rise
Stating terms or dates the user did not give
Sending without checking recent support issues
